residual_technical_risk_carried_forward.recording_cost: recording buffers per-step samples for the whole episode and performs file I/O at close. It is neutral with respect to the simulated result but not free in RAM or wall-clock, and could in principle trip the per-step wall timeout.
residual_technical_risk_carried_forward.mitigation: this is the SAME recording mode used by J1, J3, J5 and J6. Each of those runs completed its full 500-step episode and wrote its sim_outputs without tripping any wall timeout - J3's leaf, for example, holds 19 sim_outputs files. That is measured precedent for ONE recorded episode per process, and it is evidence, NOT a guarantee for the six-cell matrix.
residual_technical_risk_carried_forward.unmeasured: six recorded episodes run sequentially in a single process is NOT covered by those precedents. Each cell builds and closes its own environment, so each recorder is rebuilt per cell, but cumulative memory and wall-clock across the six have never been measured. No claim is made that the matrix will complete.
residual_technical_risk_carried_forward.if_it_fires: a TECHNICAL failure, fail-closed, committing nothing - never a behavioural result
